futureImplementationMayTouchOnlyIfSepara: DemoMessageHandler or equivalent PacketEntities diagnostic hook

failClosedPreservation.diagnosticModeIfApproved: record compact metadata before throwing the same missing-entity error
failClosedPreservation.postBoundaryBehavior: no continuation and no mutation application after missing entity

antiDisguiseRules: A diagnostic ledger must not move the bit cursor to bypass an error.
A diagnostic ledger must not fabricate registry entries.
A diagnostic ledger must not mark missing updates as applied.
A diagnostic ledger must not convert skipped payloads into progress.
A diagnostic ledger must reject incompatible recovery/truncation combinations.
